messages:
matt (eng-releases): quick idea — lightweight 'release-annotator' bot to standardize pins, change-windows, and release-note templates. low lift, big ops win for handoffs.

sara (release-lead): yes pls. can it auto-summarize PR titles into a bulleted notes draft? also we need a canonical pin syntax (model@sha or service:tag) so teams don't invent formats.

nina (swe): +1. propose a single slash command: `/release annotate` with flags: `--pin`, `--window`, `--notes-template`, `--owner`. examples would help.

matt (eng-releases): sketching a couple CLI/bot examples — paste below:
```
# create an annotation but don't apply pin yet (dry-run)
/release annotate 
  --service payments:1.4.2 
  --window "2026-03-21T02:00Z/2026-03-21T03:00Z" 
  --notes-template "short: {{pr_titles}}
impact: low
rollout: gradual" 
  --dry-run

# apply pin + publish notes and create change-channel
/release annotate 
  --apply 
  --service payments:1.4.2 
  --owner @sara 
  --publish-notes
```

jordan (oncall): how would rollback work? oncall needs a single escape hatch that says `rollback to last-stable` or `pin to previous`. and it should show a quick diff of endpoints affected.

matt (eng-releases): thought about two helpers: `--pin-back` (revert pin to previous recorded version) and `--rollback --reason "issue" --notify #incidents`. example: 
```
# pin back to previously recorded stable tag for payments
/release annotate --service payments --pin-back --confirm

# emergency rollback with notification stub and dry-run summary
/release annotate --service payments --rollback --reason "latency spike" --dry-run
```

sara (release-lead): include a `safety` flag that auto-creates a channel stub with the release metadata and a checklist: rollback command, telemetry links, and owner. we should be able to toggle `--safety=on|off`. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: preflight: all checks passed for payments:1.4.2 (CI build 5421) — created draft release note at /releases/drafts/5421

nina (swe): for templates, propose three short presets: `tiny` (1-2 bullets), `standard` (PR titles + risk + rollout), `expansion` (detailed checklist + observability pointers). also allow teams to supply `--notes-json` with structured sections.

jordan (oncall): can we make rollback idempotent and require an approval if window is outside maintenance hours? e.g., `--require-approval` toggles a two-person confirm.

matt (eng-releases): yes — default behaviour: if `--window` outside allowed windows, require `--require-approval` or an explicit `--force`. also add `--reason` to the audit log entry.

sara (release-lead): operational ask — the bot should emit a small YAML blob we can check into the release manifest: `pins`, `window`, `notes_url`, `safety_channel`. keeps everything auditable.

matt (eng-releases): agreed. example YAML the bot would write to the draft: 
```yaml
release: payments
version: 1.4.2
window: 2026-03-21T02:00Z/2026-03-21T03:00Z
notes: /releases/drafts/5421
pin_history:
  - 1.4.1
  - 1.4.0
safety_channel: #incidents-payments-5421
```

sara (release-lead): next steps: matt, can you drop a tiny PR with the bot command handlers + a 'tiny' template and a sample manifest output? assign to @nina for templates and @jordan for rollback UX review.

matt (eng-releases): will do, opening PR shortly and pinging owners. planning to land a minimal PoC that only supports `--apply`, `--pin-back`, `--window`, and notes `tiny` template.

nina (swe): thanks — will prototype a notes template and a one-click publish button in the console if we like it.

jordan (oncall): optional: add a `--preview` link that renders the release note with current observability graphs (cpu/latency) so we don't hit publish blind.

matt (eng-releases): good call — adding `--preview` to the list. will include in PR description.

sara (release-lead): thanks all. feel free to iterate in the PR and we can test next week's change window.

matt (eng-releases): tagging owners in the PR now: @sara @nina @jordan. thanks! :rocket:
